children: The Canadian dollar strengthened against the greenback on Friday, and the yield on benchmark government debt climbed.
was trading 0.1% higher at C$1.4239 to the greenback, or 70.23 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.4224 to 1.426.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) rose 2.9 basis points to 3.671%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.9016%.
futures rose 86 cents to $84.54 a barrel on Friday.
